name: ScriptableVariable<T>
src_typeComment: Base for SO-based shared value containers ("SO Variables"): instead of a hard singleton reference, multiple independent scripts read/write the SAME value by pointing at the SAME asset — a health bar UI and the player's damage logic can both reference one "PlayerHealth" FloatVariable asset without ever referencing each other directly. Unity doesn't allow [CreateAssetMenu] on a generic type, so this is abstract — see FloatVariable/IntVariable/BoolVariable for the ready-to-use concrete assets.  Note: with default Editor settings (domain reload enabled), a variable asset's value resets to its saved default each time you exit Play mode, so this behaves like ordinary runtime state, not a permanent record — use SaveSystem/JsonHelper for anything that needs to persist across sessions.

src_serialized.name: value
src_serialized.tooltip: The value other scripts read/write through this asset.
